finalText:
**Redis outage cascaded into an OOM crash and took prod down.**

Redis died at 02:14:07, `[app.log:182](logs/app.log:182)`.
Cache fell back to direct store reads.
Timeouts and queue depth climbed for 17 minutes.
Redis reconnect attempts 0 through 12 all failed.
Queue depth passed the max of 500.
`worker-2` hit heap out of memory, `[app.log:717](logs/app.log:717)`.
Supervisor then killed the api process group, `[app.log:719](logs/app.log:719)`.

Next: restart Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379`, then the service.
